course.title: Unit 4 Why don’t you talk to your parents?【例句】

sentences.content: What’s wrong?
sentences.english: What's wrong ?
sentences.chinese: 怎么了？

sentences.content: I’m really tired because I studied until really late last night, so I didn’t get enough sleep.
sentences.english: I'm really tired because I studied until really late last night , so I didn't get enough sleep
sentences.chinese: 我真的很累，因为昨晚学习到很晚，所以睡眠不足。

sentences.content: Why don’t you go to sleep earlier this evening?
sentences.english: Why don't you go to sleep earlier this evening ?
sentences.chinese: 今晚你为什么不早点睡觉呢？

sentences.content: What’s the matter, Peter?
sentences.english: What's the matter , Peter ?
sentences.chinese: 怎么了，Peter？

sentences.content: I had a fight with my best friend. What should I do?
sentences.english: I had a fight with my best friend . What should I do ?
sentences.chinese: 我和我最好的朋友吵架了。我该怎么办？

sentences.content: Well, you should call him so that you can say you’re sorry.
sentences.english: Well , you should call him so that you can say you're sorry
sentences.chinese: 嗯，你应该给他打个电话，这样你就能道歉了。

sentences.content: You look sad, Kim. What’s wrong?
sentences.english: You look sad , Kim . What's wrong ?
sentences.chinese: 你看起来很伤心，Kim。怎么了？

sentences.content: Well, I found my sister looking through my things yesterday.
sentences.english: Well , I found my sister looking through my things yesterday
sentences.chinese: 唉，昨天我发现我妹妹在翻我的东西。

sentences.content: She took some of my new magazines and CDs.
sentences.english: She took some of my new magazines and CDs
sentences.chinese: 她拿走了我的一些新杂志和CD。

sentences.content: Hmm … that’s not very nice. Did she give them back to you?
sentences.english: Hmm ... that's not very nice . Did she give them back to you ?
sentences.chinese: 嗯……这可不怎么好。她把东西还给你了吗？

wordDetails.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

sentences.content: Yes, but I’m still angry with her. What should I do?
sentences.english: Yes , but I'm still angry with her . What should I do ?
sentences.chinese: 是的，但我还是很生她的气。我该怎么办？

sentences.content: Well, I guess you could tell her to say sorry.
sentences.english: Well , I guess you could tell her to say sorry
sentences.chinese: 嗯，我想你可以让她道个歉。

sentences.content: But why don’t you forget about it so that you can be friends again?
sentences.english: But why don't you forget about it so that you can be friends again ?
sentences.chinese: 但为何不把这事放下，这样你们就能重归于好了呢？

sentences.content: Although she’s wrong, it’s not a big deal.
sentences.english: Although she's wrong , it's not a big deal
sentences.chinese: 虽然她错了，但这没什么大不了的。

sentences.content: You’re right. Thanks for your advice.
sentences.english: You're right . Thanks for your advice
sentences.chinese: 你说得对。谢谢你的建议。

sentences.content: No problem. Hope things work out.
sentences.english: No problem . Hope things work out
sentences.chinese: 没问题。希望一切顺利。

sentences.content: My problem is that I can’t get on with my family.
sentences.english: My problem is that I can't get on with my family
sentences.chinese: 我的问题是我无法与家人和睦相处。

sentences.content: Relations between my parents have become difficult.
sentences.english: Relations between my parents have become difficult
sentences.chinese: 我父母之间的关系变得紧张了。

sentences.content: They fight a lot, and I really don’t like it.
sentences.english: They fight a lot , and I really don't like it
sentences.chinese: 他们经常吵架，我真的很不喜欢这样。

sentences.content: It’s the only communication they have.
sentences.english: It's the only communication they have
sentences.chinese: 这是他们唯一的交流方式。

sentences.content: I don’t know if I should say anything to them about this.
sentences.english: I don't know if I should say anything to them about this
sentences.chinese: 我不知道是否应该就此事向他们说些什么。

sentences.content: When they argue, it’s like a big, black cloud hanging over our home.
sentences.english: When they argue , it's like a big , black cloud hanging over our home
sentences.chinese: 当他们争吵时，就像一大片乌云笼罩在我们家上空。

sentences.content: Also, my elder brother is not very nice to me.
sentences.english: Also , my elder brother is not very nice to me
sentences.chinese: 而且，我哥哥对我也不是很好。

sentences.content: He always refuses to let me watch my favorite TV show.
sentences.english: He always refuses to let me watch my favorite TV show
sentences.chinese: 他总是拒绝让我看我最喜欢的电视节目。

wordDetails.definition: refuse（第三人称单数）: 拒绝

sentences.content: Instead he watches whatever he wants until late at night.
sentences.english: Instead he watches whatever he wants until late at night
sentences.chinese: 相反，他会看任何他想看的东西直到深夜。

wordDetails.definition: watch（第三人称单数）: 观看
want（第三人称单数）: 想要

sentences.content: I don’t think this is fair.
sentences.english: I don't think this is fair
sentences.chinese: 我认为这不公平。

sentences.content: At home I always feel lonely and nervous. Is that normal? What can I do?
sentences.english: At home I always feel lonely and nervous . Is that normal ? What can I do ?
sentences.chinese: 在家时我总感到孤独又焦虑，这正常吗？该怎么办？

sentences.content: It’s not easy being your age, and it’s normal to have these feelings.
sentences.english: It's not easy being your age , and it's normal to have these feelings
sentences.chinese: 在你这个年纪并不容易，有这些感受很正常。

sentences.content: Why don’t you talk about these feelings with your family?
sentences.english: Why don't you talk about these feelings with your family ?
sentences.chinese: 你为什么不和你的家人谈谈这些感受呢？

sentences.content: If your parents are having problems, you should offer to help.
sentences.english: If your parents are having problems , you should offer to help
sentences.chinese: 如果你的父母遇到了困难，你应该主动提出帮忙。

wordDetails.definition: be（现在时复数）: 构成进行时

sentences.content: Maybe you could do more jobs around the house so that they have more time for proper communication.
sentences.english: Maybe you could do more jobs around the house so that they have more time for proper communication
sentences.chinese: 或许你可以多分担些家务，这样他们就有更多时间好好沟通了。

sentences.content: Secondly, why don’t you sit down and communicate with your brother?
sentences.english: Secondly , why don't you sit down and communicate with your brother ?
sentences.chinese: 其次，你为什么不坐下来和你兄弟好好谈谈呢？

sentences.content: You should explain that you don’t mind him watching TV all the time.
sentences.english: You should explain that you don't mind him watching TV all the time
sentences.chinese: 你应该说明你并不介意他一直看电视。

sentences.content: However, he should let you watch your favorite show.
sentences.english: However , he should let you watch your favorite show
sentences.chinese: 不过，他应该让你看你最喜欢的节目。

sentences.content: I hope things will be better for you soon.
sentences.english: I hope things will be better for you soon
sentences.chinese: 我希望你很快会好起来。

sentences.content: You look tired. What’s the matter?
sentences.english: You look tired . What's the matter ?
sentences.chinese: 你看起来很疲惫。怎么了？

sentences.content: I did my homework until really late last night, so I didn’t get enough sleep.
sentences.english: I did my homework until really late last night , so I didn't get enough sleep
sentences.chinese: 昨晚我做作业做到很晚，所以没睡够。

sentences.content: What should I do?
sentences.english: What should I do ?
sentences.chinese: 我该怎么办？

sentences.content: Why don’t you forget about it? Although she’s wrong, it’s not a big deal.
sentences.english: Why don't you forget about it ? Although she's wrong , it's not a big deal
sentences.chinese: 你何不把这事放下呢？虽然她有错，但也不是什么大不了的事。

sentences.content: What should he do?
sentences.english: What should he do ?
sentences.chinese: 他该怎么办？

sentences.content: He should talk to his friend so that he can say he’s sorry.
sentences.english: He should talk to his friend so that he can say he's sorry
sentences.chinese: 他应该和他的朋友谈谈，这样他就能说道歉了。

sentences.content: Maybe you could go to his house.
sentences.english: Maybe you could go to his house
sentences.chinese: 也许你可以去他家。

sentences.content: I guess I could, but I don’t want to surprise him.
sentences.english: I guess I could , but I don't want to surprise him
sentences.chinese: 我想我可以，但我不想让他感到意外。
